[SKU-V06 / VENDOR / INFOR WMS]

Infor WMS cost

Infor WMS (legacy SCE) is sold either standalone perpetual or bundled inside Infor CloudSuite Industry+ on AWS. Quote-only. The bundle discount has steepened through 2025-26 to push customers off perpetual.

Quote onlyMID-MARKET / saas / on-premsource ->
[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Subscription within CloudSuite bundle or standalone perpetual; quote only[s-07].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Standalone perpetual vs CloudSuite Industry+ bundle.
  • Industry vertical: distribution, fashion, food and beverage all have prepackaged CloudSuite editions.
  • AWS-hosted multi-tenant vs single-tenant on AWS.
  • Named-user count plus module pile-on (Labor, Yard, Billing).
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

Infor has been steering customers to CloudSuite Industry+ on AWS as the default path. Standalone Infor WMS / SCE perpetual still sold but the discount math now favours the bundle.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • 3PL or distribution running other Infor CloudSuite modules (M3, LN, A+).
  • Fashion or food and beverage where vertical CloudSuite editions cover the master data model out of the box.
  • Manufacturing distribution wanting WMS tightly coupled to Infor ERP.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

Standalone or CloudSuite?

If you already run another Infor CloudSuite, take the bundle. If not, standalone perpetual is still sold but the discount math now favours the bundle.

How does Infor WMS compare to Korber?

Both target mid-market 3PL and distribution. Korber leads on heritage stack flexibility; Infor leads on vertical CloudSuite editions.
